facts.fact: Ulises 复盘：在这座鬼镇什么都没捞到还赔了自由；想念 El Patio、Casanova、Sans Souci 的夜生活。
facts.anchor: But he’d gained nothing in this forsaken town, and lost his liberty.

facts.fact: 他盯着端盘子的 Inés 出神：「腿真好看」，还想到她穿晚礼服的样子；「Murder. 她居然敢把杀人的事说得这么轻巧」。
facts.anchor: She had great legs. That was the first thing he’d noticed, and that abundance of black hair.

facts.fact: Perla 当众羞辱：他想加入多米诺牌局，她一句「拿什么玩？」全桌哄笑；Cándido 落井下石，他退场。
facts.anchor: “With what money?” Perla asked, so loudly that everyone laughed.

facts.fact: 门外抽烟自骂「冤大头+窝囊废」；逐一排除出路：不偷银行、不当打手、不拉皮条——路只剩一条。
facts.anchor: He was a sap. Yeah, that was right.

facts.fact: 铁门口对话：她回绝跟 Bartolo 走的建议——「换一座笼子」；「我想你懂笼子这回事」，两人互认同类。
facts.anchor: That’s just a different cage.” She paused and looked at him. “I think you know about cages.”

facts.fact: 毒方定稿：haba de San Ignacio 籽或多种草药混进雪莉酒，「死得快、不带动静」。
facts.anchor: The seeds of the haba de San Ignacio are toxic.

facts.fact: 合流宣言：分开谁都不敢，凑一起「杀人不但可行，简直命中注定」；「什么时候动手？」「今晚，材料我都有」。
facts.anchor: But together, homicide became not only plausible but preordained.

facts.fact: 他接手给 Perla 放洗澡水（原是 Inés 的活），端上毒酒托盘；她却质问「你为什么盯着 Inés 看」（她从窗口看见了门口密谈）。
facts.anchor: Later that evening he drew his wife’s bath.

facts.fact: 他故意说「她就是小镇姑娘那种好看」激怒 Perla，赌她会借酒浇愁——她摔了一只杯子、吼他出去，雪莉酒一口没喝（换了龙舌兰）。
facts.anchor: “No, she’s not. She’s pretty in the way small-town girls can be,” he said, and he knew this comment would irritate Perla greatly, for she herself was a small-town girl.

facts.fact: 午夜露台：Nepomuceno 与他看星星、「回望世界的废墟与灵魂的破布」、讨了最后一支烟——死亡预兆。
facts.anchor: “Gazing at the stars,” the professor said, and he looked up.

facts.fact: 清晨：Perla 鼾睡未喝酒；雪莉酒瓶失踪；Rita 一声尖叫——Nepomuceno 死在扶手椅上，洒了的就是那瓶毒酒。
facts.anchor: In the morning, he tiptoed into Perla’s room; she was peacefully snoring.

facts.fact: 处置：他吼「老不死的自己喝了」，定调「我们守口如瓶」；她的脸换上士兵般的决心，他抱了她一下——「像抱住一团幽灵」。
facts.anchor: “He drank it. The old coot drank it,” he said furiously.
